[RFCS.4] **A fact-ref slot is carried as a handle.** A fact-ref is an *intra-engine*
reference to another fact in the same working memory, with no identity outside
the engine. Within one stream the referenced fact's `fact_id` names it, so that
is what a fact body carries ([RFCS.6.3]). The handle means nothing outside the
stream that recorded it: a fact that leaves the engine is a `FactExternal`,
which inlines the facts it refers to ([RFCS.23]). (`Json`-
typed slots *do* travel — encoded as their `proto_source` maps them, `TYPE_STRING`
carrying the canonical serialized JSON text.)

Prefix `RFCS`.
